verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud/Background Agents can 'start dev servers, open the app in a browser, click through UI flows, and verify their changes work' and capture screenshots/videos/log references as evidence — a form of live-app verification, but this is agent-driven QA/testing rather than interactive debugging (no breakpoints, stack inspection, console/network tooling, or step-through debugging is documented). Missing for 10: documented breakpoint/step-debugging integration, console/network inspection tools, and evidence of interactively debugging a running app rather than just launching/verifying it via scripted UI flows.
